verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that self-hosted CodeRabbit runs the core review agent inside your own infrastructure instead of CodeRabbit's cloud, and the FAQ confirms self-hosting as an Enterprise offering with extra data-retention controls. However, the evidence is a single overview line plus an FAQ mention, and access is gated to the Enterprise tier. Missing for 10: self-hosting outside the Enterprise tier, deployment/setup documentation, clarity on feature parity with the cloud product (e.g. Triage, Slack agent, IDE/CLI), and independent hands-on corroboration.
